title: Round-trip Fidelity
description: As a user, I want my exported model to re-import unchanged so that the format is trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Given any schema-valid fixture, when exported and re-imported, then the resulting diagram is identical in structure and layout

App itself renders correctly when served (see QA-STEP-7 visual check: 0 console errors, canvas mounts). Failures appear environmental/pre-existing (compose tests service runs fresh npm ci --ignore-scripts), NOT caused by STORY-019 serialization changes.

QA-STEP-7: visual-qa - served app-STORY-019 (database-diagram-webapp:st019) on network qa-STORY-019; ran visual_check.py (asg-visual-qa:1.49.1) at 1280x720/1920x1080/768x1024 -> 0 console errors all viewports; 0 layout defects at 1280x720 and 1920x1080; 1 pre-existing horizontal-scroll-inside-component defect on div.diagram-canvas-container at 768x1024 (content 984px vs visible 768px). Screenshots: qa-artifacts/STORY-019/screenshot-*.png, visual-report.json.

QA-STEP-8: visual-qa round-trip E2E (qa-tools/scripts/round_trip_e2e.py, asg-visual-qa:1.49.1) against http://app-STORY-019:8080/ -> added table 'users' + column 'id', exported JSON (version 1.0.0, users table present), re-imported via file input, verified table 'users' reappears after re-import -> ROUND-TRIP DATA FIDELITY CONFIRMED through real UI. Screenshots: rt-01-initial..rt-04-after-reimport.png.
